info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_International Payment Details API
info.description: The International Payment Details API enables consumers to access detailed information regarding specific international payment transactions. This API allows users to retrieve payment status, recipient details, and transaction logs, which are essential for transparency and tracking. Common use cases include customer inquiries regarding payment statuses and reconciliation purposes for financial institutions. Developers can integrate this API into their applications to enhance user experiences surrounding international payment processes.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for international payment PAY-300045
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about the international payment with the identifier PAY-300045. It includes insights into the transaction's status, amounts, and other relevant details, assisting in tracking and processing payments seamlessly.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the retrieval of payment details for a specific international payment identified by the payment ID PAY-300045. Ensure that you provide the correct identifiers to fetch the intended payment information.

GetPaymentDetailsForInternationalPayment.description: This schema represents a request body for getting payment details in the context of international payments under the specified operations.
